title: 手機使用
description: 手機使用相關的日常用語

sentences.en: The battery on my phone, which I charged to full capacity last night, has already dropped to twenty percent by noon.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚充滿電的手機電池，到中午已經降到百分之二十了。

sentences.en: After updating the operating system to the latest version, several apps that previously worked fine started crashing unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 將作業系統更新到最新版本後，幾個之前正常運作的應用程式開始意外當掉。

sentences.en: The phone case I ordered online, which was advertised as shockproof and waterproof, cracked the first time I dropped it.
sentences.zh: 我在網路上訂購的手機殼——號稱防摔防水——第一次掉落就裂開了。

sentences.en: To transfer photos from your phone to your computer, you can either use a USB cable or upload them to cloud storage.
sentences.zh: 要將照片從手機傳到電腦，你可以使用USB傳輸線或上傳到雲端儲存。

sentences.en: The notification settings, which I customized to reduce distractions during work hours, have significantly improved my focus.
sentences.zh: 我為了減少工作時間的干擾而自訂的通知設定，大幅改善了我的專注力。

sentences.en: Having accidentally deleted all my contacts, I had to restore them from a backup that was fortunately saved to the cloud.
sentences.zh: 不小心刪除了所有聯絡人之後，我不得不從幸好有存到雲端的備份中恢復它們。

sentences.en: The screen protector, which I applied carefully following the instructions, already has a small bubble in the corner.
sentences.zh: 我按照說明小心貼上的螢幕保護貼，角落已經有一個小氣泡了。

sentences.en: If your phone suddenly becomes unresponsive to touch, try holding down the power button for ten seconds to force a restart.
sentences.zh: 如果你的手機突然對觸控沒有反應，試著按住電源鍵十秒鐘來強制重新啟動。

sentences.en: The facial recognition feature, designed to unlock the phone quickly and securely, sometimes fails in low-light conditions.
sentences.zh: 臉部辨識功能——設計來快速且安全地解鎖手機——有時在低光源環境下會失敗。

sentences.en: Before selling your old phone, make sure to perform a factory reset so that none of your personal data remains on the device.
sentences.zh: 在賣掉舊手機之前，請確保執行恢復原廠設定，這樣你的個人資料就不會留在裝置上。

sentences.en: The wireless charger that my friend recommended, which supports fast charging at fifteen watts, works with most modern smartphones.
sentences.zh: 我朋友推薦的無線充電器支援十五瓦快充，適用於大多數現代智慧型手機。

sentences.en: Although I enabled the do-not-disturb mode before the meeting, an emergency alert still managed to come through.
sentences.zh: 雖然我在會議前啟用了勿擾模式，但一則緊急警報還是傳了進來。

sentences.en: The storage space on my phone is almost full because I have too many apps installed and thousands of unorganized photos.
sentences.zh: 我手機的儲存空間幾乎滿了，因為我安裝了太多應用程式，還有數千張未整理的照片。

sentences.en: Switching from one mobile carrier to another, which used to be a complicated process, can now be done in minutes.
sentences.zh: 從一家電信業者換到另一家——以前是很複雜的過程——現在幾分鐘就能完成。

sentences.en: The voice assistant on my phone, which I use to set reminders and send messages, has become remarkably accurate at understanding context.
sentences.zh: 我手機上的語音助理——我用它來設定提醒和發送訊息——在理解上下文方面已經變得非常準確。

sentences.en: To reduce eye strain while using your phone at night, activate the blue light filter that adjusts the screen color temperature.
sentences.zh: 要減少晚上使用手機時的眼睛疲勞，請啟動會調整螢幕色溫的藍光濾鏡。

sentences.en: The app that I downloaded to track my daily steps and sleep patterns has been surprisingly accurate compared to dedicated fitness devices.
sentences.zh: 我下載來追蹤每日步數和睡眠模式的應用程式，與專用健身裝置相比準確得令人驚訝。

sentences.en: After dropping my phone into water, I immediately turned it off and placed it in rice, hoping the moisture would be absorbed.
sentences.zh: 把手機掉進水裡之後，我立刻關機並把它放進米裡，希望水分會被吸收。

sentences.en: The fingerprint sensor located on the side of the phone, which replaced the rear-mounted one, is much easier to reach.
sentences.zh: 位於手機側邊的指紋感應器取代了之前在背面的設計，觸及起來容易多了。

sentences.en: Taking a screenshot on this phone requires pressing the power button and volume down button simultaneously, which can be tricky.
sentences.zh: 在這支手機上截圖需要同時按下電源鍵和音量降低鍵，這可能有點難操作。

sentences.en: The mobile data plan that I subscribed to last month includes unlimited calls, texts, and twenty gigabytes of high-speed internet.
sentences.zh: 我上個月訂閱的行動數據方案包含無限通話、簡訊和二十GB的高速網路。

sentences.en: While trying to update my phone's software, the download kept failing because the Wi-Fi connection was too unstable.
sentences.zh: 在試著更新手機軟體時，下載一直失敗，因為Wi-Fi連線太不穩定了。

sentences.en: The camera on the newest model, which features optical image stabilization, takes remarkably sharp photos even in motion.
sentences.zh: 最新型號的相機配備光學影像穩定功能，即使在移動中也能拍出非常銳利的照片。

sentences.en: Enabling location services on your phone allows navigation apps to provide accurate directions, though it may drain your battery faster.
sentences.zh: 在手機上啟用位置服務讓導航應用程式能提供準確的方向指引，但可能會更快耗盡電池。

sentences.en: The phone that I bought two years ago still functions perfectly, proving that expensive upgrades are not always necessary.
sentences.zh: 我兩年前買的手機仍然運作良好，證明了昂貴的升級並不總是必要的。

sentences.en: After connecting my phone to the car's Bluetooth system, I can make hands-free calls and stream music without any cables.
sentences.zh: 將手機連接到車子的藍牙系統後，我可以免持通話和串流音樂，不需要任何線材。

sentences.en: The parental control settings, which limit screen time and restrict certain content, are essential for children using smartphones.
sentences.zh: 限制螢幕使用時間和特定內容的家長控制設定，對於使用智慧型手機的兒童來說是必要的。

sentences.en: To extend your phone's battery life throughout the day, reduce the screen brightness and close apps running in the background.
sentences.zh: 要讓手機電池撐過一整天，請降低螢幕亮度並關閉在背景運行的應用程式。

sentences.en: The dual-SIM feature, which allows me to use two phone numbers on one device, is incredibly convenient for separating work and personal calls.
sentences.zh: 雙SIM卡功能讓我在一台裝置上使用兩個電話號碼，對於區分工作和私人電話非常方便。

sentences.en: Customizing the home screen layout with widgets that display weather, calendar events, and news saves me from opening multiple apps.
sentences.zh: 用顯示天氣、行事曆事件和新聞的小工具自訂主畫面版面，讓我不用開啟多個應用程式。
